---
params:
  stand_list:       NULL
  title:            "Revierbuch"
  has_zuwachs:      false
  has_bonitaet:     false
  stand_metadata:   NULL
  increment_label:  NULL
  layer_label:      NULL
title: '`r paste0("\\fontsize{14}{16}\\selectfont Revierbuch ", params$title)`'
date: ""
classoption:
  - a4paper
geometry:
  - portrait
  - "left=1.2cm,right=1.2cm,top=1cm,bottom=1.2cm"
fontsize: 10pt
header-includes:
  # The tables are emitted via cat() from asis chunks, so pandoc never sees a
  # markdown table and does not auto-load the kableExtra table packages --
  # declare them here (otherwise: 'Environment longtable undefined').
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
  - \usepackage{longtable}
  - \usepackage{array}
  - \usepackage{fancyhdr}
  - \pagestyle{fancy}
  - \fancyhf{}
  - \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
  - \fancyfoot[C]{\thepage}
---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis")
library(kableExtra)
latex_escape <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(x)
  x <- as.character(x)
  gsub("([&%$#_])", "\\\\\\1", x)
}
```

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

oo <- options(knitr.kable.NA = "–")

has_zuwachs  <- isTRUE(params$has_zuwachs)
has_bonitaet <- isTRUE(params$has_bonitaet)

for (stand_name in names(params$stand_list)) {

  stand_dat  <- params$stand_list[[stand_name]]
  stand_area <- unique(stand_dat$stand_area_ha)
  stand_area_txt <- ifelse(
    !is.na(stand_area),
    format(round(stand_area, 4), nsmall = 4),
    "–"
  )

  # Stand name header (centered, large bold -- Peter's increment PDF style)
  cat("\\begin{center}{\\large\\textbf{Waldort: ",
      latex_escape(stand_name), "}}\\end{center}\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\noindent\\rule{\\textwidth}{0.4pt}\n\n")

  # Stand metadata (user-provided Bestandsdaten)
  meta <- NULL
  if (!is.null(params$stand_metadata)) {
    meta <- params$stand_metadata[[stand_name]]
  }

  # Bestockungsgrad from ytable data (computed) or user-provided metadata
  bgrad <- unique(stand_dat$stand_bestockungsgrad)
  bgrad <- bgrad[!is.na(bgrad)][1]
  if (!is.null(meta)) {
    user_bgrad <- purrr::keep(meta, ~ .x$label == "Bestockungsgrad")
    if (length(user_bgrad) > 0) bgrad <- as.numeric(user_bgrad[[1]]$value)
  }

  # Species Profile Index (Pretzsch)
  spi_val <- if ("spi" %in% names(stand_dat)) {
    s <- unique(stand_dat$spi); s[!is.na(s)][1]
  } else NA_real_

  # Shannon diversity index (basal-area-based)
  p_i <- stand_dat$anteil_pct / 100
  p_i <- p_i[p_i > 0]
  shannon_index <- if (length(p_i) > 1) {
    round(-sum(p_i * log(p_i)), 2)
  } else {
    0
  }

  # Pre-table meta block (flushleft with bold labels -- Peter's style)
  blocks <- character(0)
  if (!is.null(params$layer_label)) {
    blocks <- c(blocks, paste0("\\textbf{Schichten:} ",
                               latex_escape(params$layer_label)))
  }
  blocks <- c(blocks, paste0("\\textbf{Fl\\\"ache:} ", stand_area_txt, " ha"))
  if (!is.na(bgrad) && !is.null(bgrad)) {
    blocks <- c(blocks, paste0("\\textbf{Bestockungsgrad:} ",
                               format(round(bgrad, 2), nsmall = 2)))
  }
  blocks <- c(blocks, paste0("\\textbf{Shannon-Index (H'):} ",
                             format(shannon_index, nsmall = 2)))
  if (!is.na(spi_val) && !is.null(spi_val)) {
    blocks <- c(blocks, paste0("\\textbf{SPI (Pretzsch):} ",
                               format(round(spi_val, 2), nsmall = 2)))
  }
  if (!is.null(params$increment_label)) {
    blocks <- c(blocks, paste0("\\textbf{Zuwachssch\\\"atzung:} ",
                               latex_escape(params$increment_label)))
  }

  cat("\\begin{flushleft}\n")
  cat(paste(blocks, collapse = "\\\\\n"), "\n")
  cat("\\end{flushleft}\n\n")

  # Build display table
  has_schicht <- "layer_key" %in% names(stand_dat)
  has_alter   <- any(!is.na(stand_dat$alter_yr))
  has_vol     <- any(!is.na(stand_dat$V_per_ha_m3))
  has_bonit   <- has_bonitaet && any(!is.na(stand_dat$site_index))

  disp <- stand_dat |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      species_group = format(species_group, spec_lang = "ger"),
      d_q_cm        = round(d_q_cm, 1)
    )

  if (has_schicht) {
    disp <- disp |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        layer_key = c("OS", "US", "VVJ", "UeH")[as.integer(layer_key)]
      )
  }

  # Compute absolute values per stand if stand_area is available
  if (!is.na(stand_area)) {
    disp <- disp |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        V_fl_m3 = ifelse(
          !is.na(V_per_ha_m3),
          round(V_per_ha_m3 * anteil_pct / 100 * stand_area, 1),
          NA_real_
        ),
        Zuw_fl_m3 = ifelse(
          !is.na(zuwachs_m3_ha_yr),
          round(zuwachs_m3_ha_yr * anteil_pct / 100 * stand_area, 1),
          NA_real_
        )
      )
  } else {
    disp <- disp |>
      dplyr::mutate(V_fl_m3 = NA_real_, Zuw_fl_m3 = NA_real_)
  }

  disp <- disp |>
    dplyr::select(
      Baumart          = species_group,
      dplyr::any_of(c(Schicht = "layer_key")),
      dplyr::any_of(c(Alter = "alter_yr")),
      `Anteil (%)` = anteil_pct,
      dplyr::any_of(c(`Bonit.` = "site_index")),
      `Dg (cm)`    = d_q_cm,
      `N/ha`       = N_per_ha,
      dplyr::any_of(c(`Vorrat/ha` = "V_per_ha_m3")),
      dplyr::any_of(c(`Zuw/ha` = "zuwachs_m3_ha_yr")),
      dplyr::any_of(c(`Vorrat/Fl` = "V_fl_m3")),
      dplyr::any_of(c(`Zuw/Fl` = "Zuw_fl_m3"))
    )

  # Drop optional columns if all-NA
  if (!has_alter)   disp <- dplyr::select(disp, -dplyr::any_of("Alter"))
  if (!has_bonit)   disp <- dplyr::select(disp, -dplyr::any_of("Bonit."))
  if (!has_vol) {
    disp <- dplyr::select(
      disp,
      -dplyr::any_of(c("Vorrat/ha", "Vorrat/Fl"))
    )
  }
  if (!has_zuwachs) {
    disp <- dplyr::select(
      disp,
      -dplyr::any_of(c("Zuw/ha", "Zuw/Fl"))
    )
  }
  # Also drop absolute columns if stand_area is NA
  if (is.na(stand_area)) {
    disp <- dplyr::select(
      disp,
      -dplyr::any_of(c("Vorrat/Fl", "Zuw/Fl"))
    )
  }

  # Totals row
  totals_list <- list(Baumart = "Summe")
  if (has_schicht) totals_list[["Schicht"]] <- ""

  if (has_alter) totals_list[["Alter"]] <- NA_real_
  totals_list[["Anteil (%)"]] <- 100L

  if (has_bonit) totals_list[["Bonit."]] <- NA_real_

  # N/ha, V/ha are monospecific: weight by anteil to get mixed-stand totals
  wt <- stand_dat$anteil_pct / 100

  totals_list[["Dg (cm)"]] <- round(
    ForestElementsR::d_q(stand_dat$d_q_cm, stand_dat$N_per_ha * wt), 1
  )
  totals_list[["N/ha"]] <- round(
    sum(stand_dat$N_per_ha * wt, na.rm = TRUE), 0
  )

  if (has_vol) {
    totals_list[["Vorrat/ha"]] <- round(
      sum(stand_dat$V_per_ha_m3 * wt, na.rm = TRUE), 0
    )
  }
  if (has_zuwachs) {
    totals_list[["Zuw/ha"]] <- round(
      sum(stand_dat$zuwachs_m3_ha_yr * wt, na.rm = TRUE), 1
    )
  }
  if (has_vol && !is.na(stand_area)) {
    totals_list[["Vorrat/Fl"]] <- round(
      sum(stand_dat$V_per_ha_m3 * wt, na.rm = TRUE) * stand_area, 1
    )
  }
  if (has_zuwachs && !is.na(stand_area)) {
    totals_list[["Zuw/Fl"]] <- round(
      sum(stand_dat$zuwachs_m3_ha_yr * wt, na.rm = TRUE) * stand_area, 1
    )
  }

  totals <- tibble::as_tibble(totals_list)
  totals <- totals |> dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(names(disp)))

  disp_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(disp, totals)

  # kable rendering
  tbl <- knitr::kable(disp_full, "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE,
                      linesep = "",
                      format.args = list(scientific = FALSE)) |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(font_size = 8,
                              latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header",
                                                "scale_down")) |>
    kableExtra::row_spec(nrow(disp_full), bold = TRUE)

  print(tbl)

  # Post-table metadata (Bestandsform, Nutzungsart, ...)
  printable_meta <- if (!is.null(meta) && length(meta) > 0) {
    purrr::keep(meta, ~ .x$label != "Bestockungsgrad")
  } else list()

  if (length(printable_meta) > 0) {
    cat("\n\\vspace{2mm}\n")
    cat("\\noindent\\rule{\\textwidth}{0.4pt}\n\n")
    cat("\\begin{flushleft}\\small\n")
    for (entry in printable_meta) {
      cat("\\textbf{", latex_escape(entry$label), ":} ",
          latex_escape(entry$value), "\\\\\n", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\\end{flushleft}\n")
  }

  cat("\n\n\\newpage\n\n")
}

options(oo)
```
